projects.project_title: Enterprise Security Monitoring and Threat Detection using Wazuh SIEM
projects.project_description:
• In modern enterprise environments, security events are continuously generated by servers, endpoints, and applications. Monitoring these logs manually is time-consuming, inefficient, and increases the risk of missing critical security incidents. As organizations grow, the volume of security data becomes difficult to manage without a centralized monitoring solution.
• This project implements Wazuh as a SIEM solution to centrally collect and analyze logs from multiple hosts within the enterprise infrastructure. The collected logs are processed using predefined security rules and correlation mechanisms to identify suspicious activities such as brute-force login attempts, unauthorized access, malware behavior, and file integrity violations.
• The system generates real-time alerts when potential threats are detected, enabling security teams to respond quickly. A centralized dashboard provides clear visibility into security events, helping organizations proactively monitor their environment, reduce response time, and strengthen their overall cybersecurity posture.

projects.project_title: SmartProp360 – AI-Based Land Investment & Construction Risk Intelligence System
projects.project_description: SmartProp360 – AI-Based Land Investment & Construction Risk Intelligence System is an applied data science and software engineering project designed to assist individuals and small developers in making informed real estate decisions. The system focuses on three critical phases of property development: (1) land investment analysis, (2) budget feasibility planning, and (3) construction delay risk prediction. Using historical real estate data, the system applies machine learning techniques to predict land price appreciation trends and classify investment risk levels based on location and market behavior. A budget feasibility module evaluates user financial inputs such as budget and loan eligibility to determine affordable and realistic investment options. Additionally, a construction risk module analyzes project timelines and related factors to predict the probability of construction delays and generate early risk alerts. The platform is implemented using Python-based backend services, structured databases, and interactive dashboards to deliver data-driven insights in a practical and user-friendly manner. The project aims to demonstrate real-world application of data science, machine learning, and backend system design while addressing a genuine industry problem.
